label: DingTalk (钉钉)
terms_note: Automation allowed: custom group robot POST https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=… with one of three security settings — keyword, IP allowlist, or 加签 (timestamp in ms + '\n' + secret, HMAC-SHA256, Base64, URL-encoded, appended as &timestamp=&sign=); message types text / link / markdown / actionCard / feedCard; rate limit 20 messages per minute per robot, exceeding it throttles the robot for 10 minutes. Enterprise-app APIs (work notifications, group management, robot callbacks) use appKey / appSecret access tokens.

sdks: DingTalk open SDKs (Java / Python / Go / Node.js) + Stream mode event client — open.dingtalk.com

tools.name: send
tools.endpoint: POST https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token= (custom robot, HMAC-SHA256 `timestamp`+`sign`) · POST https://oapi.dingtalk.com/topapi/message/corpconversation/asyncsend_v2?access_token= (enterprise app: agent_id, userid_list, msg)

endpoints.purpose: work notifications (工作通知) to members

endpoints.call: Robot callback (HTTP or Stream) → `{msgtype, text{content}, conversationType 1

reference.limits: - Custom robots post only into the group they were added to (no DM, no reading). Enterprise apps reach members of the user's organisation; there is no cross-organisation cold messaging. - `errcode` non-zero with HTTP 200; 加签 timestamps must be within 1 hour of server time.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: Client ID (formerly AppKey) of the internal enterprise app that owns the robot; exchanged at POST https://api.dingtalk.com/v1.0/oauth2/accessToken for a 7200-second accessToken.

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: Client Secret (formerly AppSecret) of the same app (developer console, 凭证与基础信息).

config_fields.name: robot_code
config_fields.help: robotCode of the internal-app robot (developer console robot page; usually equals the app key).

send.note: One-to-one robot message (msgKey sampleText, msgParam serialized {"content": …}) to the user whose userId is `to`; message_id is processQueryKey (for the read-status and recall APIs). Users the robot may not reach come back in raw.invalidStaffIdList / flowControlledStaffIdList. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

not_offered.me: No identity endpoint exists for an app accessToken; the token call itself (POST /v1.0/oauth2/accessToken, https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/obtain-the-access_token-of-an-internal-app) is the only credential check.
not_offered.list_inbound: Messages to a robot are delivered only to the robot's callback (Stream mode or HTTP) (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/robot-overview); there is no inbox poll.
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation-history endpoint for robot chats (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/robot-overview).
not_offered.reply: Robot one-to-one chats have no threads; inbound callbacks carry a short-lived sessionWebhook instead (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/robot-overview). Use send to the same userId.
not_offered.mark_read: A robot can only query whether its own messages were read (POST /v1.0/robot/oToMessages/readStatus); it cannot mark messages read (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/chatbot-batch-query-the-read-status-of-messages).

evidence: host api.dingtalk.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
